description: Wearing an elytra: jump, then press jump again in the air to glide down to the floor, landing and sliding until the server ends the glide. Then from 20 blocks up, glide east diving (pitch 30), pull up (pitch -20: the descent flattens), glide through a curtain of weeping vines at x = 14 (gliding doesn't climb them), dive again and fly into a stone wall at x = 31 (resistance V: no damage).

world.note: Fabric client gametest defaults: flat world, no structures, time and weather frozen, no mob spawning

build: item replace entity @a armor.chest with minecraft:elytra
harness: Fabric client gametest: one client tick per frame, one server tick per client tick
